summary: This resolution expresses the House of Representatives' disapproval of European digital regulations, asserting that they unfairly burden American speech and innovation, and calls on the Trump administration and federal agencies to use diplomatic and economic tools to protect U.S. free expression and innovation while rejecting cooperation with these foreign antitrust laws.
